The '''Adner system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adner]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
